answer: Two underwriters at least ten epochs old must post 50 POA each against every answer. A pass pays them 3% of the payout; a failure burns both bonds and costs those addresses underwriting rights for twenty epochs. Funder-graph checks reject any backer sharing a funding or withdrawal address with the miner, so a farm cannot insure its own clones. A thousand fakes need two thousand distinct backers with history, 100,000 POA locked a month. Backing becomes a spiral of mutual exposure: the ember you lend is your own record, and an old jade that stumbled carries no freight at that price.
